title: Partial Thromboplastin Time (PTT)
item_service_description: <p>Basic plasma coagulation function is readily assessed with a few simple laboratory tests: the PTT, prothrombin time (PT), thrombin time (TT), or a quantitative fibrinogen determination.  The PTT test is an in vitro laboratory test used to assess the intrinsic coagulation pathway and monitor heparin therapy.</p>
